players.product: hyperscale data-center leases (>1 MW, 300+ data centers, 1.4 GW under construction) and 0-1 MW colocation / interconnection on PlatformDIGITAL

quarterly_data.signal: Lease terms of the three Northern Virginia hyperscale data centers (two in Manassas, one on the Digital Dulles campus in Sterling, each 96 megawatts) whose joint-venture interests Digital Realty agreed to buy from Blackstone on June 29, 2026: the three data centers are 100% leased to three distinct (unnamed) investment-grade hyperscale customers on 15-year leases with a blended average AA- credit rating and 3.6% annual rent escalators; two are expected to stabilize in the first half of 2027 and the third in the first half of 2028.
quarterly_data.figure: 100% leased to three investment-grade hyperscale customers; 15-year leases; 3.6% annual rent escalators; stabilization first half of 2027 (two) and first half of 2028 (one)
